newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU farm ministers attack durum wheat proposals.
newsitem.headline: EU farm ministers attack durum wheat proposals.

text.p: European Union farm ministers criticised proposals to change an aid scheme for durum wheat producers and asked their experts to continue to examine the plans, EU officials said on Tuesday.
The Commission proposed in July fixing a maximum guaranteed area for each member state that would be shared between traditional durum wheat producers.
It also proposed the obligatory used of certified seed and controls to ensure that output corresponded to planted area.
The officials said that producer countries, notably Italy, demanded bigger areas while others, such as Germany and Austria, demanded inclusion in the aid scheme.
